isDown.heading: Is Little Biggy down?
isDown.body: The indicator above reflects our latest automated check of littlebiggy.org. Little Biggy has occasional outages and maintenance windows, so a red status is usually short-lived. If it shows down, wait a few minutes and reload — this page refreshes on its own.

address.heading: The official address
address.body: littlebiggy.org is the address our index tracks. Be cautious with lookalike domains and search results on other extensions — bookmark littlebiggy.org so you always land on the site we monitor.

login.heading: Little Biggy login problems
login.body: Little Biggy needs cookies and JavaScript enabled to sign in. If the site is up but your login fails, try clearing Little Biggy's cookies, disabling extensions that block scripts, or opening the site in a private window. Persistent issues are usually on Little Biggy's side and clear on their own.

legit.heading: Is Little Biggy legit?
legit.body: Wondering if Little Biggy is legit? It has operated for years and uses escrow (Transaxe) to hold funds until an order is confirmed. It's a real marketplace, not a scam clone — though, as anywhere, trust is seller by seller. Our index tracks each seller's community endorsements and reports so you can judge reputation before you buy.

cta.heading: While you wait — browse the index

quickStart.heading: How It Works
quickStart.subheading: New to Little Biggy? Here's a quick overview of the process from start to finish.

bitcoin.title: Get Some Bitcoin
bitcoin.summary: Grab some Bitcoin so you're ready to check out.
bitcoin.intro: Little Biggy only accepts Bitcoin. You'll need to set up a way to buy some if you haven't already, so that you're ready to start ordering items.

easiestWay.heading: Easiest way
easiestWay.text: Apps you may already use, such as Revolut or Monzo, let you purchase Bitcoin inside the banking app in a few taps.

otherOptions.heading: Other popular options
otherOptions.text: A crypto exchange such as Coinbase or Kraken works just as well. They operate a bit like an online currency bureau.

proTip.label: Pro tip:
proTip.text: Buy a few pounds more than you need and round up. That extra buffer covers network fees or crypto volatility.

peerToPeer.label: Want to skip the exchange?
peerToPeer.afterLinks: let you buy Bitcoin directly from another person - no exchange account, no KYC paperwork. It's more hands-on, but the coins land straight in a wallet you control.

browse.title: Find Your Items
browse.summary: Browse the Little Biggy catalogue like you would on eBay.
browse.intro: Find items you want to buy - on Little Biggy itself or via the index. There's a huge selection, so have a good browse.
browse.trustBefore: Check product descriptions and reviews to spot trusted sellers. If unsure, Google the seller's name or look on
browse.cart: When ready, add what you want to your cart and enter your delivery details just like any other online store.

checkout.title: Checkout & Send Your Bitcoin
checkout.summary: Copy the details, then send the payment from your phone or laptop.
checkout.intro: At checkout, Little Biggy shows a private order page with everything you need to pay safely, whether you're on one device or switching between phone and desktop.
checkout.amountAfter: Copy it exactly so you do not underpay.
checkout.addressAfter: think of it as the account number for this order.

sendSteps.openApp: Open the app or exchange you used to buy Bitcoin (Revolut, Coinbase, Monzo, Kraken, etc.).
sendSteps.chooseSend: Choose the option to send or withdraw Bitcoin.
sendSteps.pasteDetails: Paste the Bitcoin address into the recipient field and the exact BTC amount into the amount field.
sendSteps.confirm: Confirm the transfer. Network confirmations usually land within a few minutes and your order page will update automatically.

escrow.title: Your Funds Are Safe (Escrow)
escrow.summary: Transaxe holds the money until your order arrives.
escrow.intro: Your Bitcoin goes to Transaxe, Little Biggy's built-in escrow system. The seller can see the payment has arrived, but the funds are held securely.
escrow.release: The money is only released to the seller once the dispute window closes. This protects you as a buyer - if something goes wrong, you can open a dispute before the window ends.
escrow.peaceText: Escrow means the seller never touches your funds until the item is shipped and received. It is the safeguard that keeps Little Biggy honest.

delivery.title: Wait for the Postie
delivery.summary: Relax while it makes its way to you.
delivery.intro: Sellers typically mark your order as shipped within one business day. Delivery times depend on the seller and your location, but most UK orders arrive within a few days.
delivery.late: If your order is late, contact the seller through Little Biggy first - most issues get resolved quickly. Only open a dispute as a last resort.

whatIs.a: The Biggy Index provides an easier way to browse the Little Biggy marketplace, with item categorisation, additional sorting options, and other handy tools tailored for UK shoppers.

sellOrShip.q: Do you sell or ship items?
sellOrShip.a: No. Biggy Index is read-only and sends you back to Little Biggy to complete your order.

dataSource.q: Where does the data come from?
dataSource.a: The index fetches public Little Biggy data, normalising categories, pricing summaries, shipping info, reviews and images.

refreshRate.a: There are 3 components that refresh at different intervals. The main indexer runs every 30 minutes. The item and seller crawlers run every 4 hours, at separate times to be mindful of Little Biggy's server.

timestamps.q: What does First Seen or Updated on items mean?
timestamps.a: First seen/created means that it's the first time the item was indexed by the crawler. This can include items which were on LB before the indexer existed. Updated means that the item was edited by the seller, or that the crawler detected a change (e.g. price, variants, description).

endorsements.a: Community votes that highlight popular items without tracking you.

payments.q: What payments does Little Biggy accept?
payments.a: Only Bitcoin - no cards, bank transfers or other cryptocurrencies.

buying.q: How do I buy Bitcoin in the UK?
buying.a: Most buyers use Revolut, Monzo, Kraken, or Coinbase. Top up in pounds, purchase the amount of BTC shown at checkout, and allow a few pounds for network or exchanging fees.

wallet.q: Do I need my own wallet first?
wallet.a: You can pay straight from the exchange, but many people move BTC into a private wallet like Cake Wallet or Trust Wallet for extra privacy. UK exchanges are required to ask where you're sending coins - so some buyers prefer routing via a personal wallet.

escrow.q: How does Transaxe escrow protect me?
escrow.a: Your payment goes to a Transaxe escrow address. Sellers have about 80 hours to mark orders as shipped or the funds auto-refund. Disputes open after nine days if needed.

mistakes.a: Copy-paste the BTC amount and address, add a buffer for fees, and keep screenshots until your parcel arrives. The blockchain cannot undo typos.

clearnet.q: Why not just use clearnet shops?
clearnet.a: Competition on Little Biggy keeps quality high and prices fair. Clearnet resellers often charge heavy markups or ship questionable stock.

legality.a: Cannabis laws still apply. You are responsible for staying within local regulations and verifying every detail on Little Biggy.

lbGuide.title: Before you go to Little Biggy...
lbGuide.subtitle: Quick tips to help you get started on the marketplace.

country.title: 1. Choose your country
country.text: Little Biggy needs to know where you are before it can show product options. Select your country first — it saves a cookie so you only need to do this once.

buy.title: 2. Browse & buy
buy.text: Once your country is set, each product shows a buy button next to every variant. Tap one and it goes straight to your cart.

account.title: 3. Create an account
account.text: You can check out without an account, but signing up is recommended. Just click "Login" then "Register" — no email needed, just a username and password.

checkout.title: 4. Pay with Bitcoin
checkout.text: Little Biggy accepts Bitcoin only. At checkout you'll see an amount and a wallet address to send payment to.

privacy.metadataDescription: How BiggyIndex handles data — no accounts, no analytics, no tracking, and only functional cookies.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: BiggyIndex is an independent, read-only index of publicly available Little Biggy listings. The site is deliberately simple, and that extends to privacy — there is very little data we could collect, and we choose not to collect more.

noAccounts.heading: No accounts, no purchases
noAccounts.body: You cannot create an account, log in, or buy anything on BiggyIndex. We never ask for your name, email address, payment details, or delivery address. Any purchase happens on Little Biggy, under Little Biggy's own terms and privacy practices — nothing about it passes through us.

noTracking.heading: No analytics or tracking
noTracking.body: We do not run analytics or advertising scripts, and we do not use tracking pixels or fingerprinting. We do not build visitor profiles, and we have no personal data to sell or share with anyone.

functionalStorage.heading: Functional cookies and local storage
functionalStorage.body: The site uses a small amount of functional storage only — a locale cookie that remembers your language and market, and browser local storage for display preferences such as dark mode. None of it identifies you. See the Cookie Policy for the full list.

listingData.heading: Where our data comes from
listingData.body: Everything shown on BiggyIndex — items, sellers, prices, reviews — is sourced from publicly available Little Biggy listings. We hold no data about Little Biggy buyers.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.body: If you have a question, or want something corrected or removed, contact us via the suggestion feature on any item page.

terms.metadataDescription: The terms that apply when you browse BiggyIndex, an independent informational index of Little Biggy listings.
terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By using BiggyIndex you agree to these terms. They are short because the site is simple — we index listings and display them, nothing more.

whatWeAre.heading: What BiggyIndex is
whatWeAre.body: BiggyIndex is an informational index. We collect publicly available Little Biggy listings and present them with search, filtering, and sorting so they are easier to browse. Nothing is bought or sold on this site, and no age-restricted sales take place here — there is no checkout, no payment, and no fulfilment of any kind.

independence.heading: Independence
independence.body: BiggyIndex is an independent project. We are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by Little Biggy. Listings, seller names, images, and reviews belong to their respective owners and are shown here for reference.

accuracy.heading: Accuracy is not guaranteed
accuracy.body: Listings change frequently and our index refreshes on a schedule, so prices, availability, shipping options, and review counts may be out of date or incorrect. Always check the original listing before relying on anything shown here. The site is provided as-is, without warranties of any kind.

outboundLinks.heading: Outbound links
outboundLinks.body: Links from items and sellers lead to Little Biggy. Once you leave BiggyIndex you are subject to that site's own terms, and we are not responsible for anything that happens there, including any transaction.

yourResponsibility.heading: Your responsibility
yourResponsibility.body: You are responsible for ensuring that anything you do after leaving this site complies with the laws that apply where you live.

changes.heading: Changes to these terms
changes.body: We may update these terms from time to time, and the latest version always lives on this page. If something looks wrong, contact us via the suggestion feature.

cookies.metadataDescription: The functional cookies and local storage BiggyIndex uses — no analytics, no advertising, no tracking.
cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: BiggyIndex uses no analytics, advertising, or tracking cookies. The only storage on this site is functional — it keeps the site working and remembers your preferences.

locale.name: NEXT_LOCALE
locale.purpose: Remembers your language and market so pages load in the right locale.

preferences.name: Display preferences
preferences.purpose: Keeps settings like dark mode and display currency in your browser. This data never leaves your device.

cookies.outro: Because none of this storage tracks you, there is no consent banner to dismiss. If you clear your browser data, the site simply returns to its defaults.

intro.flower: Flower is the biggest category on Little Biggy, running from budget smalls to imported Cali exotics. Listings are grouped by strain family — Gelato, Cookies, Runtz, OG/Kush, Haze, Zkittlez, Diesel, Cheese, Cake and more — so you can follow a genetic line you already know instead of guessing from product names. Most sellers offer several weight tiers, and the price per gram usually drops sharply at the 7g and 14g marks. Descriptions tend to note indica, sativa or hybrid leanings along with grow style. Every listing links back to the seller on Little Biggy, with reviews, delivery times and shipping costs indexed here so you can compare growers side by side before ordering.
intro.shake: Shake is the value end of the flower market: loose shake, trim and small popcorn buds, usually sold by the same growers who list full flower but at a much lower price per gram. It's a popular choice for rolling, cooking and making edibles or extracts at home, where bag appeal matters far less than cost. Quality varies more here than in any other category — some listings are mostly dust and sugar leaf, others are near-whole smalls — so seller reviews are worth reading closely. We split Shake out of Flower in this index precisely so bargain hunters can compare like for like instead of wading through premium listings.
intro.hash: Hash on Little Biggy spans traditional imports and modern solventless work. Listings are organised by processing method: Moroccan-style pressed hash, dry sift and static sift, bubble hash from ice-water extraction, soft mousse, unpressed kief, and premium forms like piatella and temple balls. Micron grades and filtration levels show up in listing details where sellers state them. UK-based makers tend toward fresher artisan batches, while imports cover the classic Moroccan and Afghan styles. Prices per gram range wider than flower, tracking quality closely — comparing review scores and delivery records across sellers is the quickest way to find hash that matches its description.
intro.concentrates: Concentrates cover the potent end of the menu: shatter, wax, crumble, rosin, live resin, diamonds and THC oils. Solventless products like rosin sit alongside butane- and CO2-extracted options, and listings usually state the extraction method and the strain it started from. Doses are small and potency is high — most concentrates are several times stronger than flower — so per-gram prices look steep but stretch much further. Typical use is a dab rig or a concentrate-capable vaporiser, and some buyers simply top flower with a little extract. Review histories are indexed for every listing, which matters in a category where texture and purity are hard to judge from photos.
intro.distillate: Distillate is THC refined to its purest practical form — a thick, golden oil that typically tests far stronger than flower or traditional extracts. Because the process strips out plant material and most terpenes, it has little flavour of its own, which makes it a flexible base: buyers use it to refill vape carts, dose edibles precisely, or dab it directly. Listings on Little Biggy usually come as syringes or jars with the volume stated up front, and review histories are indexed with each listing — useful in a category where potency claims matter more than photos.
intro.vapes: Vape listings on Little Biggy include pre-filled 510-thread cartridges, disposable pens and pods. The oil inside matters most: distillate carts are the cheapest and most consistent, while live resin and full-spectrum extracts cost more and keep more of the original strain's flavour and effect. Listings normally state the size (0.5ml or 1ml), extract type and strain. Disposables work out of the box; cartridges need a 510 battery bought separately. Counterfeits of brand-name carts are common everywhere, so a seller's review history and time on the platform are better guides than packaging — both are indexed on every listing here.
intro.prerolls: Pre-rolls take the rolling out of the equation. Little Biggy sellers list singles, multipacks and infused options — from straightforward single-strain joints rolled with flower from their own menu to blunts and pre-rolls boosted with hash or concentrates for extra strength. Multipacks bring the per-joint price down and are the usual pick for regulars; infused rolls carry a clear premium. Descriptions typically state the strain, the weight per roll and the pack count. Freshness and how well they're rolled are the usual quality complaints, so recent reviews — indexed on every listing — are the best signal before you order.
intro.edibles: Edibles on Little Biggy run from gummies and chocolate to baked goods, capsules and drink mixes. Strength is the first thing to check: listings state milligrams of THC per piece and per pack, and doses vary hugely — a sensible starting dose is 5–10mg, while some single sweets carry 100mg or more. Onset is slow, often 30–90 minutes, so the golden rule is start low and wait before taking more. Vegan and gluten-free options appear regularly. We index per-piece strength where sellers declare it, so you can compare products on dose and value rather than pack price alone.
intro.tincture: Tinctures are liquid cannabis extracts taken as drops under the tongue — a smoke-free option with faster onset than edibles and finer dose control than either. Listings on Little Biggy include THC oils, CBD blends and balanced ratios, usually stating strength in milligrams per bottle or per millilitre. Sublingual effects typically arrive within 15–45 minutes, quicker than eating and easier to titrate. Full-extract RSO-style oils appear here too, favoured by high-dose users. Bottle size, carrier oil and total strength drive the price, so the per-milligram cost is the fairest way to compare sellers — check it before judging a bottle expensive.
intro.psychedelics: Psychedelics gathers Little Biggy's non-cannabis listings: dried mushrooms, truffles, microdose capsules, and mushroom chocolates and gummies. Dried fruit is the staple, with strength varying noticeably by variety — descriptions usually name the strain and a suggested dose range. Microdose capsules offer measured sub-perceptual amounts for people following a schedule, while chocolates and gummies split a full dose into smaller, easier pieces. Set, setting and starting low matter more in this category than anywhere else on the site. Seller reviews and delivery times are indexed on every listing, exactly as with the cannabis categories.
intro.other: Other is the catch-all for listings that don't fit the main categories: CBD products, seeds, accessories like grinders and rolling supplies, and the one-off items sellers list alongside their main menu. It's worth a scan now and then because new product types tend to land here first, before there are enough listings to justify a category of their own. Expect the contents to shift week to week as sellers rotate stock. Every listing still carries the same indexed data as the rest of the site — price, seller history, review scores and shipping options — so an unusual item can be vetted exactly like a mainstream one.
